title: Add end-to-end integration tests for Optimize quality gating (pass/fail/override)
author: Leila Farouk
description: This PR adds an end-to-end integration test suite for Optimize quality gates that exercises the full control-plane path we rely on in production: create recommendation w/ config diff → trigger gate run against eval-harness → persist pass/fail decision + artifacts → enforce at apply boundary (block/allow) → override path (time-bound) allows apply and emits audit events. Motivation: we had multiple PRs touching gating enforcement (state machine, schema validation, eval-harness retries, apply blocking, overrides). Unit tests cover each piece, but we were missing a single suite that validates the contract between services and the enforcement invariants that prevent unsafe config changes from reaching production. What’s included: (1) New `gating_e2e` integration tests that spin up Optimize service + dependencies (Postgres/Redis) and a lightweight fake eval-harness server implementing the trigger + results endpoints used by Optimize. (2) Scenarios: PASS gate → apply succeeds; FAIL gate → apply is rejected with explicit reason + gate_run_id; FAIL gate + override granted (not expired) → apply succeeds; override expired → apply blocked again; idempotency/duplication: re-applying with same config diff reuses latest gate result; audit trail: gate_started/gate_completed and override_granted events are written with expected fields. (3) Test harness utilities: stable clock injection for override expiry testing, request correlation IDs, and deterministic fake eval-harness responses to avoid flakiness. (4) CI wiring: adds a dedicated required check `integration/gating-e2e` that runs only when gating-related directories change (Optimize gating code, schemas, apply boundary, overrides). Notes/limitations: These tests intentionally do NOT run GPU evals; they validate contract/enforcement and persistence. Model-quality behavior is exercised in eval-harness repo. The fake eval-harness supports: success, regression failure, flaky response requiring a single retry, and timeout. Follow-ups: extend suite to cover rollout-controller promotion gating once ENG-3928 lands; add a EU-region timeout regression test once we have a stable way to simulate cross-region latency in CI.
commits: test(gating): add e2e harness scaffolding and service bring-up helpers
test(gating): cover pass/fail apply enforcement with real DB persistence
test(gating): add override path (grant/expire) and audit event assertions
ci: add integration/gating-e2e required check with path filters
chore: tighten timeouts + cleanup test logs for CI readability
review_conversation: Jordan Lee (review): Love that this asserts the apply boundary behavior. Can we also assert the error payload includes the gate_run_id + a stable reason code (not just message text), so Console can reliably render it?

Leila Farouk (author): Good call. Added assertions for `reason_code=QUALITY_GATE_FAILED` and `gate_run_id` presence; also updated fake harness to return an artifact pointer so we can validate the link is stored.
Olivia Grant (review): Fake eval-harness: please ensure it matches the retry semantics we documented (single retry on 5xx, no retry on 4xx). Right now it retries on any non-200.
Leila Farouk (author): Updated: only retries on 502/503/504, and test now covers a single 503 followed by success. Added a guard to fail if we retry on 400.
Yara Haddad (review): Can we add one scenario that ensures static validation failures short-circuit (no eval-harness call) so we don’t burn eval budget on invalid diffs?

Leila Farouk (author): Added `TestGatingE2E_InvalidDiff_SkipsEvalHarness` with an invalid quant profile + incompatible model family. The fake harness tracks call count; assertion ensures it stays at 0.
Connor O'Brien (review): CI change: can we path-filter so this doesn’t run on every docs-only PR? Also add a hard timeout; we’ve seen integration jobs hang under load.

Leila Farouk (author): Added path filters under `services/optimize/internal/gating/**`, `services/optimize/internal/overrides/**`, `services/optimize/tests/integration/**`, and schema dirs. Added a 25m job timeout and per-test 2m context timeout.
Sahana Iyer (review): Flake risk: the tests currently bind to random ports; we’ve had rare collisions in GitHub runners. Prefer `localhost:0` and reading the listener addr back.

Leila Farouk (author): Switched fake harness and Optimize test server to `:0` listeners and plumbed the resolved address into the client config. Also set `GOMAXPROCS=2` for the job to reduce noisy scheduling variance.
Jordan Lee (review): One more ask: the override expiry test should use injected clock rather than sleeping, otherwise it will be flaky.
Leila Farouk (author): Done. Introduced `override_clock.go` and used a fixed clock advanced in-test; removed sleeps.
Olivia Grant (approval): LGTM. The fake harness behavior looks aligned with our current trigger contract.
Jordan Lee (approval): Approved. This gives us a lot more confidence for the limited rollout.
Connor O'Brien (approval): Approved from CI side; thanks for the path filters and timeouts.
release_notes: Internal: added end-to-end integration coverage for quality-gate enforcement (pass/fail/override) and a required CI check for gating-related changes.
